newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RESEARCH ALERT - Fraser upgrades Comfort.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Fraser upgrades Comfort.

text.p: Fraser Securities said on Thursday it had upgraded its earnings estimate for Comfort Group Ltd after the taxi operator changed its accounting policy.
Fraser said in its research report that Comfort had added about Singapore $2 million to bottomline numbers by adjusting its depreciation period to seven years from six.
On Wednesday, Comfort said the 23.2 percent rise in its six months profits to S$16.01 million was largely due to the change in accounting policy and an expansion of its taxi operations.
Fraser said the change would offset the start-up costs of Comfort's S$23 million satellite communication system.
Fraser said the new system had the potential to raise Comfort's revenue to S$18 million a year.
Fraser's forecast of Comfort's full-year net profit ending March 1997 is at S$30.4 million.
